opening.text: Isabella Rodriguez, your campaign manager, is reviewing polling data when you enter the campaign office.
opening.speaker: narrator

segments.speaker: isabella
segments.text: The polls are tight. Your vote on the Education Reform Bill could make or break this campaign. What's your read on the situation?

choices.text: "I'm voting my conscience. The polls will follow."
"What do the numbers say we should do?"
"I need more time to think about it."

segments.speaker: isabella
segments.text: She looks at you with a mix of frustration and respect. "That's either courageous or suicidal. Time will tell."

segments.speaker: isabella
segments.text: "Make your vote. I'll manage the fallout. That's my job." She gives you a look that says she's got your back, no matter what.

consequences.high_respect: Isabella will defend your decisions publicly
consequences.high_trust: Isabella will provide honest counsel even when uncomfortable
consequences.low_trust: Isabella may question your judgment in crisis
